scope: Fixed/wildcard/mixed ARRAY formal constraints over existing checked references and values

contracts.source: Direct fixed/mixed dimensions, normalized inline layers, module constants and bounded pure calls; strict wildcard-only parsing retained
contracts.scope: Module-only interfaces; no parameter/local/caller reads; three logical dimensions and bounded fixed/minimum sizes
contracts.reference: Matching bare storage retains concrete schema and identity; no resizing or equal-count reshape
contracts.forwarding: Compatible unknown borrowed dimensions defer only anonymous ARRAY size constraints to unchanged concrete routine-entry checks; preserve aliases and formal write effects
contracts.values: Grouping, ordinary data prefixes, results and existing typed source conversions keep independent writable copies
contracts.resources: Existing FILE borrowing/no-copy, logical PATH/queue and BYNAME ownership and shape checks; no implicit data or service allocation
contracts.linkage: Exact declaration/definition signatures after normalization; fixed and wildcard interfaces are not interchangeable
contracts.lifetime: Existing pause/resume/stop and partial effects; wrong concrete shapes reject before callee frame/body, without rolling back earlier argument/caller effects
contracts.metadata: Scoped declaration and forwarding constraints, source origins and explicit runtime validation; generic parameter_accepts remains unchanged
